reading: record-clearing is robust to any single rare ref: all seven refits stay in 51.83-52.86 val cIoU, every one above the training-free record (51.32); worst case (k4 fit ref removed) is +0.51 over the record. The magnitude of the weight increment over tau-only (52.15) is NOT uniformly robust: it concentrates on the single k4 fit ref (removing it costs 0.95 and flips the held-out tau to 0.25, landing 0.32 below tau-only); the k3 and k5 fit-ref masses are neutral (+0.01, +0.002) and the composition/base perturbations move val by <= 0.14 (dropping a held-out rare ref from the composition alone slightly helps: +0.07 to +0.14)
